cohort: The study included women aged 18-45 years who delivered at Khyber Teaching Hospital, comprising cases diagnosed with PPD or PPP within six months postpartum and controls without psychiatric diagnoses, matched by age, parity, and delivery mode.
finding: Preeclampsia/eclampsia, postpartum hemorrhage, preterm birth, and gestational diabetes mellitus were significantly associated with an increased risk of postpartum psychiatric disorders.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between cesarean delivery and the risk of postpartum psychiatric disorders.
